Single continuous first-person observation of this exact wooden desk. Only the unmarked paper and ordinary desk objects remain in view. Gentle natural camera motion. No hands or new objects enter. No player face, body, reflection or over-the-shoulder view. No captions, writing, titles, labels, cards, lists, tables, screen text, blur patches, masks, mosaic or overlays. Real paper props must stay unmarked or seen obliquely out of focus through natural photography; do not add postproduction panels.

SPOKEN DIALOGUE WHITELIST IS EMPTY. No dialogue, no narration, no extra human voice, no muttering or reading. Any visible man listens with lips gently closed. Quiet breathing or a natural blink is allowed, but no sustained speaking mouth shapes. No BGM, no background music, no score, no singing or musical rhythm. Only soft location ambience and action-synchronous natural sound.
